questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.
Keep a risk list with a response for each; include a rules change. Check with a local expert.
Written contracts and signed copies for every helper, even part-time.
Start with one area and one guest type, such as visiting families or workers on short jobs.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster B, Technology and digital services: Strong fit: near-shoring means firms need IT support, testing, security and cloud services in Spanish.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.
Language: Spanish first, in plain words; add English only if customers ask.
Many customers use bank transfers, cash-payment points and cards; a lot of buying is on messaging apps.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Partner with cleaners, key handlers and a repair person; write call-out times.
Show real photos, house rules and guest reviews on each listing. Check with a local expert.
Write MXN next to every number.
Register with the tax authority (a tax ID) before you invoice; choose sole trader or company. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Check short-stay rules, any tax on rental income, safety checks and building rules before listing. Check with a local expert.
Customers may ask to see, correct, remove or object to use of their data; set a reply time.
Launch with a go or no-go rule on occupancy and complaints. Check with a local expert.
Cluster F, Food and farming: Strong fit: food and farming are central; check health-risk rules for food and alternative proteins. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Employers register staff for social security and pay the year-end bonus; budget both.
Register with the tax authority (a tax ID) before you invoice; choose sole trader or company. Check with a local expert.
Cluster A, Online selling and marketing: Strong fit: messaging-app selling and marketplaces. Offer cash-payment and bank-transfer options.
Trust: tax ID, address, delivery days and a refund note on every page; consumer rules apply. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Keep a list of every tool that stores customer data, including messaging apps.
Dates: first test, first order, first review.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.
Compare models: list homes for a fee, manage homes for owners, or run leased homes. Pick by risk.

Register with the tax authority (a tax ID) before you invoice; choose sole trader or company. Check with a local expert.
Cluster G, Money services (regulated): Regulated money services; plan as a partner of a licensed firm only. Check with a local expert.
Partner with cleaners, key handlers and a repair person; write call-out times.

questions.q: In "Launch plan and review Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Partner with a technical college or business chamber to find helpers and to practise.
Keep marketing consent records; offer a clear way to stop messages.
A monthly review: what we planned, what happened, what we change.
Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
